units.source_text: “今天是陪这位先生一起来的。

en.t: I came here today accompanying this gentleman.

units.source_text: 你大概也了解，这位先生……”

en.t: You probably understand already, this gentleman...

units.source_text: 拉卟接着开始不停的介绍我的情况。

en.t: Rapp then began introducing my circumstances without stopping.

units.source_text: 像是为自己很少来这个大寺院来辩解。

en.t: It was as though he were making excuses for seldom coming to this great temple.

units.source_text: “我希望邀请您给这位先生做向导。”

en.t: I would like to ask you to serve as this gentleman's guide.
